title: Bamboo
body:
Description

Bamboo spawns around the Acid Area, Ook Lake, The Oasis, and the beach near Radical Shack. It was once one of the most profitable "tree" to farm before the Island Expansion Update, only overshadowed by Palm.

Its appearance consists of a short and thin base with no branches or leaves other than the thin protrusions on the main trunk, although its real life counterpart has both. Its raw variant uses a pre-2022 Sand roblox material and seems to be Moss colored. Its processed variant uses Pre-2022 Sand roblox material and seems to be Lily White colored.

Bamboo should be very tall, grow in groups and generally not in sandy areas. But in this the opposite is the bamboo that, scattered grows, is very low and in the lower right corner of the largest sandy beach there.

Trivia

  • Technically, Bamboo isn't a type of tree; it's officially classed as a type of grass. It is the fastest growing plant in real life.
  • Bamboo was one of the last trees to get added before public alpha release. The others being Petrified Oak and Palm.
  • Bamboo is one of two trees to use an unusual mesh for its segments and is hollow inside. The other tree to have a unique mesh is Cactus.
  • After 1.3.0. all tree prices were increased by 1.25x. They were increased further in 1.3.3. by 1.4x.
